Compare the HP, modified HP and fully modified HP filters

Source: R/batch.R
fmhp_compare.Rd

fmhp_compare() filters one series with the three filters and compares their cycles and their end-point loss (Hanif et al. 2017, Tables 3a and 3b): the HP filter at the conventional \(\lambda\) of the frequency, the modified HP filter and the fully modified HP filter.

Usage

fmhp_compare(
  x,
  frequency = c("quarterly", "annual", "monthly"),
  max_lambda = 3000L,
  log_scale = TRUE,
  end_share = 0.1
)

# Default S3 method
fmhp_compare(
  x,
  frequency = c("quarterly", "annual", "monthly"),
  max_lambda = 3000L,
  log_scale = TRUE,
  end_share = 0.1
)

Arguments

x

a numeric vector or a ts object, without missing values; at least 5 observations.

frequency

"quarterly" (default), "annual" or "monthly".

max_lambda

the largest \(\lambda\) of the searches over \(1, 2, \dots,\) max_lambda (default 3000, as in the published code).

log_scale

filter the logarithm of the series (default TRUE, as in the published code).

end_share

share of the observations counted as ends on each side (default 0.1, as in Table 2 of the paper).

Value

A data.table with one row per filter (HP, Modified HP, Fully modified HP) and the columns method, lambda, cycle_sd, cycle_mean, ar1, cycle_range, gcv, loss, sd_ends, sd_middle.

Details

Besides the moments of mhp_compare(), the table gives the total loss \(L\) of each filter (hp_loss()), its standard deviation of the cycle at the ends (the first and last end_share of the observations) and in the middle. A filter without end-point bias has a loss near zero and about the same cycle variability at the ends as in the middle.

See also

fmhp_filter, mhp_compare, hp_loss

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

data(us_macro)
fc <-
  fmhp_compare(
      x          = us_macro$gdp
    , frequency  = "quarterly"
    , max_lambda = 3000
    , log_scale  = TRUE
    , end_share  = 0.1
    )
fc
#>               method lambda   cycle_sd    cycle_mean       ar1 cycle_range
#>               <char>  <num>      <num>         <num>     <num>       <num>
#> 1:                HP   1600 0.01543904  4.942713e-12 0.8668207  0.08590516
#> 2:       Modified HP    683 0.01333176 -1.634336e-13 0.8280266  0.07801575
#> 3: Fully modified HP   1448 0.01618038 -4.145448e-05 0.8815215  0.08713978
#>             gcv      loss    sd_ends  sd_middle
#>           <num>     <num>      <num>      <num>
#> 1:           NA 1.7617778 0.01458541 0.01568213
#> 2: 0.0002819926 1.7652928 0.01202396 0.01366805
#> 3: 0.0003335623 0.7898641 0.01930994 0.01538061
